reading_note: The teaching describes the heavenly kingdom — the realm where divine love and wisdom dwell in their perfection. The arc moves from the announcement of this realm (the Land of Light = heaven), through its inhabitants (the "rich gods" = angels who came forth from the Father/Lord and are summoned to him), through its features (trees, fruits, the living ambrosia or drug = perceptions and truths that give eternal life), to its essential character (no falsehood, no death) and culminates in the recognition that the truth itself constitutes this realm and reveals it to the one who will know. The single arc: the spiritual reality of heaven as the form of divine good and truth, populated by recipients who live from the Lord and in the Lord.
